full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE DILG OPINION NO. 95 S. 2010 28 May 2010 SB MEMBER RAFFY CAMPOS San Pedro, Laguna Dear SB Member Campos: This has reference to your earlier letter asking the Department's legal opinion on the following legislative measures duly approved by the Sangguniang Barangay of Barangay San Antonio, San Pedro, Laguna, to wit: 1) Kapasiyahan Bilang 2008-009, entitled: "Kapasiyahang Pinagtibay ng Sangguniang Barangay na Magpasa ng Kautusan Hinggi/ sa Pagtatakda ng Passway Fee sa Bawat Biyahe ng Trak ng Basura at Iba Pang Sasakyan na Nagtatapon ng Basura at Naghahakot ng Quarry Materia/s sa Nasasakupan ng Barangay'} and 2) Kautusan Bilang 2008-001, entitled: 'Kautusang Nagtatakda ng Passway Fee sa Bawat Biyahe ng Trak ng Basura at Iba pang Sasakyan ng Nagtatapon ng Basura at Naghahakot ng Quarry Materia/s sa Nasasakupan ng Barangay. " In reply thereto, please be informed that since the foregoing legislative measures-had undergone the procedural process for their enactment under the Local Government Code of 1991 (RA 7160), the same are considered valid unless declared otherwise by our courts of justice. Any issues or questions thereon as to the substantive validity and enforceability of the aforesaid legislative measures should be threshed out by filing a special civil action for Declaratory Relief before the proper court in accordance with Section 1, Rule 63 of the Revised Rules of Court, which provides that: "SECTION 1. Who may file petition.—any person interested under a deed, will, contract or other written instrument, or whose rights are affected by a statutory executive order or regulation, or ordinance may, before breach or violation thereof, bring an action in the appropriate Regional trial Court to determine any question of construction or validity arising, and for a declaration of his rights or duties thereunder." Thank you and warm regards. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: . JESUS . DOQ IV Director III Ls/17
